description: SetFit event classifier distilled from the pipeline's weak labels, evaluated on the 380-row hand-labeled gold set.
training: SetFit (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 80MB) on 150 class-balanced weakly-labeled headlines (25/class), 2 epochs, 102s on T4

pipeline_baseline.note: agreement of the deployed pipeline with the same gold

results.kernel_macro_f1_bug: the kernel reported macro_f1 1.1586 due to a /3-vs-/6 classes bug; corrected value computed from the saved predictions

interpretation: The distilled student MATCHES its teacher (58.2% vs 59.2%, within noise) - the expected weak-supervision outcome confirming the 59.2% ceiling is label noise, not model capacity. Value delivered: the event classifier can now run as a deterministic 20ms MiniLM model on every path (live, backfill, fallback) with no accuracy loss, replacing three labeling paths and dropping the zero-shot NLI model from the image. Raising the ceiling itself requires better labels, which the LLM live path provides for new data.
kernel: sachingoyal27/setfit-train v13 (102s train on T4 x2)
